lemma pays_surplus (hg : ∀ j x, W.betaEntry j ≤ x → ∀ i, StepStages j i → CubicGate D q j i x) {x : ℝ}
    (hm : m < N) (hV : flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅)
    (h : |vacuumError B N Q V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * (funds B.a m q / 2)) : let A := board B N F
    |predictor B N Q x * A.leg V + A.background V - contrast (target Q) V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * funds B.a m q := by

proof_context.conclusion: `|predictor*leg V + background V - contrast (target Q) V x| <= sites n * funds`, i.e. `|b_u K_pr + L_m(V) - log H(1)/H(V)| <= |Λ| c_pre ε`.

structure Income (B : Directed G I Z K P) (N m p : ℕ) (q : ResetPrices) (s : Set ℝ) (Q : In B.a m p)
    (V : Config G (B.a.S.side m p)) (F : Terms B.a m p) : Prop where
  catalog : Catalog (board B N F) s (window B.a m q) (B.a.clock.allowance m) (B.a.clock.forcedAllowance m)
  pos : ∀ x∈s, 0 < target Q x 1 ∧ 0 < target Q x V
  surplus : ∀ x∈s, let A := board B N F
    |predictor B N Q x * A.leg V + A.background V - contrast (target Q) V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * funds B.a m q
  slow : ∀ x∈s, ∀ a∈window B.a m q, ∀ b∈window B.a m q,
    |(board B N F).add V x b - (board B N F).add V x a| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * funds B.a m q * |b-a|

proof_context.conclusion: `surplus` field of `Income`: the same bound with `A.leg V`, `A.background V` and `contrast`.
